statement: ∀ fc : LR.FirstChange p K M, letI := fc.ak; ∃ (af : Algebra (ZMod p) K) (mq : Module (ZMod p) (LR.QMR p M)), letI := af; letI := mq; ∃ D : (K ⊗[LR.R p] LR.QMR p M) ≃ₗ[K] (K ⊗[ZMod p] LR.QMR p M), ∀ c u, D (c ⊗ₜ[LR.R p] u) = c ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] u
proof:
classical
intro fc
letI := fc.ak
letI : CharP K p := h_H002
letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨h_H001⟩
letI : Algebra (ZMod p) K := ZMod.algebra _ _
have hkill : ∀ q : LR.QMR p M, p • q = 0 := by
  intro q
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := (LR.pMR p M).mkQ_surjective q
  rw [← map_nsmul, ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul (LR.R p), Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
  exact ⟨u, rfl⟩
letI : Module (ZMod p) (LR.QMR p M) := AddCommGroup.zmodModule hkill
have frac (r : LR.R p) : ∃ z : ZMod p, (∀ c : K, r • c = z • c) ∧ (∀ q : LR.QMR p M, r • q = z • q) := by
  obtain ⟨a,b,hb0,hb,hr⟩ := (h_T005 r).mp r.property
  have hbz : (b : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by simpa [CharP.intCast_eq_zero_iff] using hb
  have he : (b : LR.R p) * r = a := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (b : ℚ) * (r : ℚ) = (a : ℚ)
    rw [hr]
    field_simp
  refine ⟨(a : ZMod p) * (b : ZMod p)⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro c
    simp only [Algebra.smul_def, fc.rho_value a b r hr hb, map_mul, map_intCast, map_inv₀, div_eq_mul_inv]
  · intro q
    apply smul_right_injective (LR.QMR p M) hbz
    rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel_right₀ hbz]
    rw [Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul (LR.R p), smul_smul, he]
    simp only [Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]
letI : SMulCommClass (LR.R p) (ZMod p) K := ⟨by intro r z c; simp only [Algebra.smul_def]; ring⟩
letI : TensorProduct.CompatibleSMul (ZMod p) (LR.R p) K (LR.QMR p M) := ⟨by
  intro r c q
  obtain ⟨z,hk,hq⟩ := frac r
  rw [hk, hq, TensorProduct.smul_tmul]⟩
letI : TensorProduct.CompatibleSMul (LR.R p) (ZMod p) K (LR.QMR p M) := ⟨by
  intro z c q
  rw [← ZMod.intCast_zmod_cast z]
  simp only [Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]
  exact TensorProduct.zsmul_tmul _ _ _⟩
refine ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance, TensorProduct.equivOfCompatibleSMul (ZMod p) (LR.R p) K K (LR.QMR p M), ?_⟩
intro c u
rfl
